en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus Bin Abdul Rahman, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Hamza Bin Muhammad, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws, said, ‘I asked himasws about the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [90:10] And pointed out to him the two conspicuous ways, heasws said: ‘The way of good and the evil’.
